content:
Tom starts with 50 trees. Each year, he plants 10 trees and chops down 2, resulting in a net gain of 8 trees per year. Over 10 years, the net gain is 10 × 8 = 80 trees. So after 10 years, he has 50 + 80 = 130 trees. Then 30% of the trees die, meaning 70% survive. 130 × 0.7 = 91 trees remain.

Answer: 91
